_comment: Anchors and thresholds for EmbeddingClassifier. score = max similarity to a mode example minus max similarity to a routine phrase. Thresholds were tuned on testdata/golden/golden_notifications.json only; the holdout set is for checking, never tuning.
routine: Special offer: 30% discount on your next purchase
Weekly newsletter with tips and stories
Friend sending a casual message about weekend plans
App update is available to install
Your food order is being prepared
Daily news digest and trending topics
Game reminder: come back and play

examples: Heavy traffic on your route, take alternate road
Your bus arrives in 4 minutes at stop 12
Boarding has started for your flight
Urgent call from family, please pick up
Gate has changed for your flight
Deadline is today, need status update
Emergency alert issued for your area
Family member in hospital, come immediately
Your relative is in the hospital
